(2) An extreme close-up of the white credit card follows, showing the "cube" logo and the bank name "Cathay United Bank". The card is held by the man's thumb. (3) A screen recording shows the CUBE App interface on a smartphone. A finger taps on various menu items like "Credit Card" and a green "2024" icon. (4) The man is back on screen, holding the smartphone and talking animatedly. He points at the screen while looking at the viewer. (5) Another screen recording shows stylized graphics of an apple tree ("Pomegranate Apple Tree") representing spending habits, followed by charts of top spending categories. (6) The man continues his presentation, laughing and showing surprise at his own spending data on the phone screen. (7) A close-up of a questionnaire page on the smartphone screen with 5-star rating options. (8) The man points his finger at the camera in a closing gesture, inviting the audience to try the app.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a clear male voice greeting the audience with high energy. A light acoustic guitar track with a steady, rhythmic strumming pattern begins simultaneously. The environment sounds professional and studio-clean. (2) A digital 'pop' sound effect is heard as the presenter transitions to holding the bank card. The speaker continues at a moderate conversational pace, with friendly and rising intonations. (3) The music remains constant as the speaker explains app navigation. His speech rate increases slightly when describing his excitement about the 2024 review feature. (4) A subtle 'whoosh' sound effect punctuates the transition to a screen recording. The BGM maintains a bright, major-key tonality without interfering with vocal clarity. (5) The speaker chuckles slightly, followed by a brief moment where the music is more audible during a rhetorical pause. (6) Another digital UI 'click' sound effect coincides with tapping on the smartphone screen shown in the demo. (7) The speaker's tone becomes more persuasive and authoritative as he explains the rewards and surveys. The acoustic guitar rhythm persists until the very end. (8) The video concludes with a strong vocal sign-off and call to action. The music fades out slightly before the final hard cut.
